about: Scenarios (rulebook 59.0-64.0) and their initial land deployments. A deployment's 'at' is a hex ('hex', section letter + number as in the rulebook), several hexes the units may be split between ('hexes'), an off-map box ('box', see data/map/offmap.json), a hex the units must be within 'within' hexes of ('near'), or an area described in words ('area'), drawn at 'anchor' when one is given and otherwise listed for the player to place. Hexes are as printed in the rulebook except where 'fix' notes a correction. Units are listed as the rulebook gives them; parent formations bring their subordinate units as on the OA Sheets. A unit's 'type' and 'size' (echelon: XX, X, III, II, I) are from data/vocab.json; 'size' is left out where the counter shows none or it is not yet known, and 'nat' defaults to the deployment's. 'rules' name the rulebook cases with the rest of each setup (air, trucks, supply, fleet, special rules). A setup's 'initiative' gives the side with the Initiative at the start, fixed through Game-Turn 'through' (7.15); 'may_roll' if the players may roll for it instead, and 'text' to show.

scenarios.name: Graziani's Offensive
scenarios.summary: September 1940: the Italian Tenth Army crosses into Egypt. Six weeks to take Sidi Barrani and beyond, or for the Commonwealth to push the Italians back over the wire.

scenarios.name: The Italian Campaign
scenarios.summary: Graziani's advance followed by Operation Compass, O'Connor's counter-offensive, through to February 1941. Victory points for the towns each side holds at the end.

scenarios.name: The Race for Tobruk
scenarios.summary: March 1941: Rommel and the first units of the Afrika Korps strike from El Agheila against a stretched Commonwealth line. Whoever holds Tobruk at the end wins. The rulebook's pick for a fast, approachable game.

scenarios.name: Operation Crusader
scenarios.summary: November 1941: the Eighth Army attacks to relieve besieged Tobruk while Rommel prepares his own strike east. Mass armoured battles between Sollum and Tobruk.

scenarios.name: The Last Chance
scenarios.summary: October 1942 at El Alamein: one week for the Axis to break through the Commonwealth line and reach Alexandria. Short, and nearly impossible for the Axis.

scenarios.name: The Long Retreat
scenarios.summary: From El Alamein to the end of 1942: can the Axis army escape the Eighth Army's pursuit intact?

scenarios.name: The Campaign for North Africa
scenarios.summary: The whole war in North Africa, September 1940 to January 1943, from the Italian set-up. Meant for teams of at least three players a side.

scenarios.name: The Campaign from Rommel's Arrival
scenarios.summary: The shorter campaign game: from the Desert Fox set-up in March 1941 to January 1943, with reduced Axis and Commonwealth replacements (Cases 64.53-64.54).
